description: 대구광역시_대구버스정보시스템 [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 대구광역시. 이용자가 제공받고 싶은 서비스의 조건에 맞는 입력값(ex: 노선ID, 정류장ID 등.. )을 작성하여 대구버스시스템의 기본적인 정보 및 특정 노선과 정류장에 대한 상세한 정보와 실시간. Coverage: 대구광역시. The portal files it under the publisher 대구광역시. Its tags are 대구, 교통, 버스, 정보, 데이터. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-07-31 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
